condition: Unauthorized access to protected health information constituting a suspected privacy breach
evaluationParameters: Electronic audit logs confirm that the coworker’s unauthorized access ended and identify the records or information accessed
The privacy investigation and required follow-up are completed according to facility policy, including any indicated notifications or corrective measures
missingInformation: What information the coworker viewed, how long access lasted, and whether information was copied, disclosed, or otherwise used
The facility’s specific privacy-response policy and the applicable jurisdictional notification requirements
Whether the coworker had any legitimate role-based authorization not described in the stem
priorityActions: Immediately stop and prevent further unauthorized access to the electronic record
Report the incident through the facility’s privacy and incident-response process
reasoning: Opening a client’s electronic record without a care-related role is unauthorized access and a suspected privacy breach. The stem directly supports stopping access and initiating formal reporting; audit-log findings and completion of the privacy response best determine whether the event was contained and appropriately addressed.
